notes: Copy script's pasted install line for a file under a long folder name (text_encoders, diffusion_models), repeated three or four times in one line, was long enough that a web terminal's paste split it mid-quote and stranded the shell on a continuation prompt waiting for input that never finished arriving. Each file's download is now several short lines built around one shell variable instead of one long one — the same line that stalled dropped from 620 characters to 281.
